DEF-130.title: InLine VAST document containing only NonLinearAds (no Linear creative) is flagged vast.mediafile_missing
DEF-130.expected: VAST 4.4 section 3.12 (NonLinearAds): within an InLine ad, at least one of <Linear> or <NonLinearAds> must be provided. <MediaFile> (section 3.9) is a child of <Linear> and is not required when the only Creative content is <NonLinearAds> delivered via <StaticResource>.
DEF-130.actual: The exact reviewed deviations are pinned separately for each case and layer; successful or unrelated findings are not admitted as gaps.
notes: Normative assertions were authored from primary protocol/vendor contracts before execution. Known-gap signatures document observed failures only; they are not expected output snapshots.

rules-vast.js R4 (vast.mediafile_missing) gates only on hasInLine and a document-wide <MediaFile> tag search; it does not special-case a Creative whose only child is <NonLinearAds>, so a fully spec-valid non-linear-only InLine ad is misclassified as missing media.
crosscheck.bid.video_vast is unaffected (it only sniffs the <VAST> root element) — the deviation is confined to the response-side validateVast() findings.
